scope: Independent native Settings persistence acceptance for EXT-D-0084 and EXT-D-0086

source_review.reset_oracle: Full local/session baseline census with salted key/value fingerprints. A synthetic unsent draft is seeded through the trusted Chat UI and required to be nondefault before reset. Chat is exempted only when the exact version-1 guest default shape is observed. False guest admin gate, known guest/session/discovery defaults, and test-owned session fixture are named explicitly; no wildcard key whitelist is used.
source_review.admin_reset_finding: The admin run failed the reset retry census on matrx.user.isAdmin. Source shows signOut removes STORAGE_KEYS.IS_ADMIN through writeAdminGate(null), then the post-reset reload enters the guest boot path which writes false. The oracle accepts an unchanged false gate but its changed-value branch does not accept this exact true-to-false signed-out default transition. The raw receipt does not expose the boolean, so this is a source-explained oracle limitation, not proof that the runtime value was false. No runner/source changes or repeat launch were made in this lane.
source_review.biome_formatter_override: Added an exact three-file formatter-only override for the immutable raw receipt copies in this evidence folder. Lint remains enabled; the normal summary remains formatter-checked.

shared_limits: Storage fault injection validates the real Settings UI handlers and Chrome storage boundary; it does not prove a healthy desktop engine, actual pairing acceptance, or rediscovery.
HTTP-only Forget remained unavailable in all three native profiles, so the role receipts are partial.
These runs are bounded persistence coverage and do not satisfy the full EXT-F-1003 T43-T51 inventory.

quality_verdict.evidence: Guest/member reset census and all visible persistence cases passed. The admin role exposed a missing exact signed-out default transition in the reset census oracle. Commit 733caf33 adds the narrowly scoped false guest admin-gate transition and explicit guest UI/token/profile/admin post-reset assertions. That correction landed after these runs and was not exercised by this lane; a fresh admin native verifier must confirm it.
